title: Maharashtra likely to declare 10 more talukas drought-hit; around 1 crore farmers get ₹5,000 advance

ai.summary: Maharashtra government likely to declare 10 more talukas drought-hit amid farmer protests, with 1 crore farmers receiving ₹5,000 advance despite pending payments for 10 lakh due to record discrepancies.

facts.claim: Maharashtra government likely to take a decision on Tuesday on a proposal to declare 10 more talukas drought-hit
facts.quote: The Maharashtra government is likely to take a decision on Tuesday on a proposal to declare 10 more talukas drought-hit, including some in the state's Western and Konkan regions.
around one crore farmers have received the first advance assistance of ₹5,000 announced by the state government as part of drought relief.

facts.claim: Payments to nearly 10 lakh farmers are still pending due to discrepancies
facts.quote: payments to nearly 10 lakh farmers are still pending due to discrepancies between their bank and beneficiary records.

ai.background_note: Farmers in Maharashtra are protesting for drought status in their talukas after exclusion from previous drought declarations, leading to potential inclusion of 10 more talukas and advance payments.
